'''Shuttle S257''' was a [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy|naval forces]].<ref name="Stealth Strike" /> Sometime in [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Stealth Strike]]" takes place in [[4 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref> the [[shuttle]] was stolen by the rebels of [[Phoenix Cell]], where it was used by [[Kanan Jarrus]] and [[Rex]] in their [[Rescue on the Imperial Interdictor|mission]] to an [[Interdictor (Interdictor-class)|experimental]] [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]] in order to rescue Jarrus' [[Padawan]], [[Ezra Bridger]], and [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]].<ref name="Stealth Strike" />

==Description==
A [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]], Shuttle S257 was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]] generator and [[Comm unit|communications]] system which was compatible with the communications of an [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]]. The [[shuttle]] also came armed with its own weapon systems near its forward ramp and along its articulated wings.<ref name="Stealth Strike" />
